mechanism: Benazepril (ACE inhibitor) reduces aldosterone secretion while torsemide (loop diuretic) causes potassium and sodium depletion, creating opposing effects on electrolyte balance and blood pressure with increased risk of hyperkalemia and hypotension.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and blood pressure regularly; adjust diuretic dose as needed; counsel patient on dietary potassium intake and signs of hyperkalemia.
